name: card/gloss-sweep
title: Gloss sweep card
title_vi: Thẻ nhãn có vệt bóng quét chéo
desc_vi: Thẻ nhãn gọn đáp xuống mạnh dứt khoát, một vệt bóng chéo quét qua đúng một lần, rồi đứng yên hoàn toàn.
params_vi: text: chữ trên thẻ · accent: green | blue | violet (bộ màu thẻ) · sweepAngle: góc vệt bóng, -60 đến 60 độ · duration: độ dài gốc 2.5 s (chỉ ảnh hưởng khi ngắn hơn 1.35 s) · bg: màu bóng đổ · fg: màu chữ gốc
notes: Layout, colours and motion as in the source: card min-width 48cqw, max-width 78cqw, min-height 34cqh, padding 7cqh 9cqw, border 0.22cqmin in the edge colour, radius 5cqmin, 145deg gradient bright -> surface, shadow 0 3cqh 8cqh plus a 0.12cqmin white inset ring; label 15cqmin weight 780 tracking -0.04em; the three palettes green / blue / violet (surface, bright, edge, label colours) are the source's. Motion: card y -5cqh -> 0 and scale 1.06 -> 1 over 0.5 s expo.out; the gloss layer (opacity 0 outside the sweep) is shown at 0.65 s, its custom property --gs-sweep tweens -30 -> 130 over 0.7 s power2.out (it moves the five gradient stops across the card at the given angle), then it is hidden again; when `duration` is shorter than 1.35 s the phases compress together. The gradient is driven by a CSS custom property, so ae is png. Differences: the label gets 0.15em vertical padding (cancelled by a negative margin) so Vietnamese stacked diacritics are not clipped by the source's overflow hidden at line-height 1; the card shadow colour comes from the param bg (the source's --bg token, default #05070d); the source's `clamp(8cqmin, 15cqmin, 18cqmin)` is written as the resolved 15cqmin; the source's full-box transparent background stays transparent. Default text is Vietnamese (source: Pro).
